purpose: Attribution metadata to attach to each record at publish time. Key each published record by its provider/jurisdiction to the matching variant below.

keyBy.rule: provider == 'CSO PXStat' -> cso ; provider == 'NISRA' OR jurisdiction == 'Northern Ireland' -> nisra

cso.appliesTo: All CSO PxStat records (provider = 'CSO PXStat', jurisdiction != 'Northern Ireland').
cso.attributionText: Contains Irish Public Sector Data licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0) licence.
cso.sourceUrlNote: sourceSlugOrId is the PxStat matrix code (e.g. BDR03). Human-facing table page is the /table/{code} URL; the JSON-stat cube used for staging is the api.restful ReadDataset URL.

nisra.appliesTo: NISRA records (provider = 'NISRA') and any record with jurisdiction = 'Northern Ireland'. These are Crown/Northern Ireland public sector data, NOT CSO CC-BY.
nisra.attributionText: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.
nisra.rightsHolder: Northern Ireland Statistics and Research Agency (NISRA)
nisra.sourceUrlNote: NISRA slugs are not uniformly PxStat matrix codes across the corpus; verify each record's resolved source URL from its staging localPath/reference before publishing. Where no clean per-record URL is derivable, cite providerHome. These records must carry OGL attribution or be deferred pending per-record source-URL resolution.
nisra.carveout: 35 of these records have provider = 'CSO PXStat' but jurisdiction = 'Northern Ireland' (CSO cubes about NI). Licence origin is CSO CC-BY, but they are held out of the CC-BY auto-publish tranche for manual review; do not auto-apply OGL to these without confirming the true rights holder.
